verified_facts.text: The hotel is set in the Capital Gate tower, which leans 18 degrees.

verified_facts.text: With its 18-degree incline, the building holds the Guinness World Record for the farthest leaning tower.
verified_facts.excerpt: With an 18-degree incline, Andaz holds the Guinness World Record for the farthest leaning tower.

verified_facts.text: The hotel is adjacent to ADNEC, the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre.
verified_facts.excerpt: located only 15 minutes from the airport and key attractions and adjacent to ADNEC

verified_facts.text: The tower stands in the Embassies District, just off one of the city's busiest thoroughfares.
verified_facts.excerpt: in the Embassies District, just off one of the city's busiest thoroughfares

verified_facts.text: The ground floor, called 165 Below, is a permanent gallery space with works by local artists.
verified_facts.excerpt: The ground floor—called 165 Below—acts a permanent gallery space, complete with works by local artists.

verified_facts.text: The public spaces are filled with ornate Middle Eastern art and decorative motifs, from intricate wooden window adornments to Islamic calligraphy and traditional woven fabrics.
verified_facts.excerpt: the public spaces are filled with ornate Middle Eastern art and decorative motifs, from intricate wooden window adornments to Islamic calligraphy and traditional woven fabrics

verified_facts.text: Bags are taken at the entrance and guests head up to the 18th floor for check-in.
verified_facts.excerpt: your bags are taken away before you head up to the 18th floor for the welcome formalities

verified_facts.text: The terrace pool is on the 19th floor, with a small lounge area and views over the city.
verified_facts.excerpt: located on the 19th floor, it has a small lounge area and incredible views

verified_facts.text: The 19th floor is also home to the fitness center and the Rayana Spa, which offers treatments and house rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: It's also where you'll find the well-equipped fitness center and the Rayana Spa, offering treatments and house "rituals."

verified_facts.text: The Lean is the hotel's pool deck, suspended high above the city, calm and sunlit by day and livelier by night.
verified_facts.excerpt: Suspended high above the city, this reimagined pool deck blends refined style with playful sophistication, inviting guests to unwind in a calm, sunlit setting by day

verified_facts.text: Rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with views over the capital.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gaze upon the capital with unsurpassed views from floor-to-ceiling windows.

verified_facts.text: Rooms feature local art and locally inspired stories.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy eclectic local art and inspired stories woven into every room

verified_facts.text: Standard rooms have a marble bathroom with a walk-in rain shower and a deep-soaking tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: an open-plan marble bathroom with walk-in rain shower and deep-soaking tub

verified_facts.text: The Andaz Suite sits at the top of the tower, with floor-to-ceiling windows looking over the Arabian Gulf and a whirlpool tub.
verified_facts.excerpt: Floor-to-ceiling windows offer breathtaking panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf, while the elegantly designed space features a king bed, a stylish lounge area, and a luxurious marble bathroom complete with a signature whirlpool tub.

verified_facts.text: The Family Room has two interconnecting rooms, one with a king bed and the other with twin beds, and two bathrooms.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring two interconnecting rooms one with a plush king bed, the other with twin beds

verified_facts.text: Room guests get complimentary access to a private beach 10 minutes from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: Cyan Brasserie blends a Parisian brasserie with French-rooted cuisine and Middle Eastern hospitality.
verified_facts.excerpt: A modern brasserie that artfully blends the classic charm of a Parisian eatery where French-rooted cuisine harmonizes with the warm hospitality of the Middle East
